title: Where Walter Nelson and musicians are now, around the Caledonia
summary: They discuss whether guitarist Walter Nelson is dead, and where musicians gather near the Caledonia Inn and Allen Toussaint's studio.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
